name: punt
description: Minimal Android task and reminder app with companion server, CLI, and web interface

scripts.build:web: esbuild src/web/main.ts src/web/index.html src/web/style.css src/web/manifest.json src/web/sw.js --bundle --minify --outdir=dist/web --loader:.html=copy --loader:.json=copy --loader:.css=copy --loader:.js=copy
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
